content: Verified against official docs: pytest.approx defaults rel=1e-6 abs=1e-12 nan_ok=False, with abs fallback existing because nothing but 0.0 is relatively close to 0.0; numpy.testing.assert_allclose defaults rtol=1e-07 atol=0 equal_nan=True. Exact-equality float tests flake across platforms because non-associative IEEE754 summation reorders under different BLAS backends (OpenBLAS/MKL/Accelerate), thread counts (OMP_NUM_THREADS), and FMA contraction. Primary example: scikit-learn .circleci/config.yml pins MKL_NUM_THREADS=OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 (verified via gh api). Prescribe tolerance-based asserts plus thread pinning before numpy import.
